description: Pins the framebuffer capture schema used by oracle visual-parity verification. Each capture entry holds a tic number, a SHA-256 hash of the raw 320x200 palette-indexed framebuffer byte array, and the active PLAYPAL palette index at capture time (0=normal, 1-8=damage red, 9-12=bonus pickup, 13=radiation suit). Entries are sorted ascending by tic; the default sampling interval is 35 tics (one second at the 35 Hz tic rate).
